answer: Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 20 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in forge and quill lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the atlas graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1339 impostors cost 994 times the honest price and take 24 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
